main_text.p: litera: ita & in philosophiâ hæc tria etiam atq; etiam considerandæ sunt: puta in Metaphysicâ, Theologiâ, Medicinâ debemus notare tria hæc cognoscendi principia. II. Cur hic in genere præcipiamus de Schola Gratiæ, quum de illâ in specie docendum sit infrà, ubi tractabimus de principiis Theologicis? Pro solutione hujus dubii notandum est, Scholam Gratiæ confide-Gratiæ Schola confideratur communiter, vel particulariter.rari communiter, & singulariter. Communiter, quatenus est regula Philosophiæ, Jurisprudentiæ & Medicinæ. Singulariter, quatenus est principium Theologicum. Nos attendimus communem illam notionem, qui persuasi sumus, philosophum hæc tria principia religiosè observare debere, Rationem, Experientiam, & Scripturam.
Schola Naturæ est principium cognoscen-Schola Naturæ quid sit?di ea, quæ homo potest capere constitutus intra terminos Naturæ, infra terminos Gratiæ.

p.i: Schola naturæ est principium cognoscendi collectivum seu aggregatum. Constituitur enim è tribus aliis principiis, subjecto scilicet, Objecto, & Me-diis.

main_text.p: Schola Naturæ continet Subjectum, Objectum,& Media.

page.notes: Marginal notes on the right are reconstructed from the small type: "Principium" at the top of the activum/passivum block is read as "Pricinpium" on the scan and is doubtful; "QUO." and "QUOD." are read as printed. Greek word ἐλλειπτικῶς is doubtful in its accents. The word "Me-diis" is set in italic and its last syllable is doubtful. The Latin "funt", "eft" and "fi" forms are normalised to sunt, est and si per the long-s rule. The line "Schola Naturæ continet..." is treated as a running paragraph.
